scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Permanent Partial Disability
description:
The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana was launched on January 1, 2021. 

This scheme is specifically designed to provide social security to unorganized workers in Bihar. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure financial assistance and social security for workers who suffer from permanent partial disabilities. 

The scheme aims to support these workers by providing them with a monthly pension. 

The amount of the pension provided under this scheme is ₹1,000 per month. 

This financial support is intended to help mitigate the economic hardships faced by disabled workers. 

The scheme targets unorganized sector workers across various industries in Bihar. 

Eligibility for the scheme includes workers who have suffered from permanent partial disabilities due to accidents or occupational hazards. 

Applicants must be residents of Bihar to qualify for the benefits. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There is no maximum age limit specified for eligibility under this scheme. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of their disability through a medical certificate. 

The application process for the Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must fill out an application form available at local government offices or online on the official Bihar government website. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, age, and details of the disability. 

Applicants must also submit a copy of their Aadhaar card for identity verification. 

A medical certificate confirming the permanent partial disability must be attached to the application. 

Once the application is completed and all documents are gathered, it should be submitted to the designated local authority. 

The local authority will review the application for completeness and eligibility. 

The processing time for applications can vary but typically takes around 30 days. 

Upon approval, beneficiaries will start receiving the pension on a monthly basis. 

The disbursement of the pension is done directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

The scheme is implemented by the Labour Resources Department of the Government of Bihar. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring timely disbursement of funds. 

Contact details for the Labour Resources Department can be found on the official Bihar government website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance social security for unorganized workers in the state. 

According to the Bihar government, there are approximately 40 million unorganized workers in the state. 

This scheme is expected to benefit a significant portion of this population. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹500 crores for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

Monitoring and evaluation of the scheme's effectiveness are conducted periodically. 

The government aims to increase awareness about the scheme among unorganized workers. 

Workshops and information sessions are organized to educate potential beneficiaries about the application process. 

The scheme is part of the larger framework of social welfare initiatives in Bihar. 

It complements other schemes aimed at providing financial assistance to marginalized communities. 

The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana reflects the state's commitment to improving the livelihoods of disabled workers. 

The government encourages eligible individuals to apply and take advantage of the benefits provided. 

The scheme is expected to reduce poverty levels among disabled workers in the state. 

It aims to promote inclusivity and empower individuals with disabilities. 

The pension amount of ₹1,000 may not cover all expenses but serves as a crucial support system. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of social security in enhancing the quality of life for disabled workers. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme aims to provide a sense of dignity and recognition to disabled workers. 

The government is also exploring partnerships with NGOs to reach more beneficiaries. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme's implementation. 

The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is a significant step towards ensuring social justice. 

It addresses the unique challenges faced by unorganized workers with disabilities. 

The scheme is part of the state's vision to create a more equitable society. 

As of October 2023, the government continues to promote the scheme actively. 

Awareness campaigns are ongoing to ensure that eligible workers are informed about the benefits available to them. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare and economic empowerment. 

It aims to create a safety net for one of the most vulnerable sections of society. 

The Bihar government remains focused on enhancing the living conditions of its citizens through various welfare schemes. 

The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is a crucial part of this broader strategy. 

Overall, the scheme represents a significant investment in the future of unorganized workers in Bihar. 

The government is dedicated to ensuring that no worker is left behind, regardless of their circumstances. 

This initiative is a vital component of Bihar's social security framework. 

It highlights the importance of supporting workers who contribute to the state's economy. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over time based on the needs of its beneficiaries. 

Future enhancements may include increased pension amounts or additional support services. 

The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is a landmark initiative in the state's welfare landscape. 

It is designed to uplift and empower disabled workers, ensuring they have access to essential support. 

The government remains committed to monitoring the scheme's impact and making necessary adjustments for improvement. 

This initiative is a crucial step towards building a more inclusive and supportive society in Bihar.
